scope: Synthetic queue intervention test, not a 5G protocol implementation or security exploit
model: Supervised diagonal Gaussian classifier, fixed variance floor 0.04 in log1p latency space; marginal passive likelihood when optional evidence expires
risk_gate: Acquire if optional evidence expired or max class posterior below 0.8; maximum 72 probes, token bucket 0.2 per tick with capacity 2
load_guard: Admit optional probe only when causal rolling observed user-arrival rate plus prospective nominal probe work per tick is below 0.95 nominal capacity; no true mechanism, future queue, or future response accessible
primary_contrast: guarded_risk minus risk; average equally across four mechanism traces within each independent seed
success: Upper paired 95% bootstrap CI of mean per-seed relative user-p95-latency change below -0.10 AND lower CI of diagnostic macro-F1 difference above -0.03; both required
secondary: Shared versus ghost user latency bias; guarded_periodic separates arrival guard from uncertainty scoring; random and periodic baselines; isolated and low-load/low-cost counterexamples; realized probe count, service work, stale evidence and healthy FPR always disclosed
calibration: Separate seeds used only to describe frozen-model accuracy and FPR; no hyperparameter or threshold optimization
intervals: 10000 seed-cluster paired bootstrap resamples; primary contrast alone confirmatory; remaining cells exploratory, no unadjusted significance claims
causal_contract: Generate exogenous arrival/work/noise arrays once per seed, load and mechanism, reuse across policies. Selected probes consume work only in shared mode. Probe values delivered only at their completion time. Missing/expired evidence falls back to passive likelihood. Labels used only for fitting and evaluation. Ghost mode is an explicitly counterfactual noninterfering probe model, not a physically realizable benchmark
limitations: Poisson arrivals, exponential user work, FCFS single queue, bounded additive path/application waits, trusted exact arrival counters, constant nominal capacity. No crypto, packet format, RF link, retries, attacks, mandatory KIE cost, multi-NF contention or hardware measurements. Supervised mechanism labels are not maliciousness labels. No scientific priority established.
